name: CO2 Impact
summary: UK carbon reporting software for small and mid-sized businesses: emissions from bills and uploads across Scope 1, 2 and 3, a carbon reduction plan, SECR reports and optional automated meter data.
best_for: UK small and mid-sized businesses that need a first carbon footprint, Scope 1-3 reporting or a carbon reduction plan for customers and tenders, without hiring a consultant
skip_if: you may want to leave within the year (every plan is a 12-month licence and fees are non-refundable), you need multi-country group reporting, or you already work with a sustainability consultancy that supplies its own tools
honest_knock: Every licence is a 12-month commitment, monthly payment included, and the licence terms make fees non-refundable. Data entry and uploads use Usage Tokens, and top-up prices appear only inside the platform. The pricing table keeps changing: Basic at £468 a year in October, £348 on 19 November, and on 22 November a new three-plan table from £468 a year (Essentials, 2 users and 2 sites) in the vendor's llms.txt, shown in euros on the homepage from outside the UK. Check the plan and the currency at checkout. We have not used CO2 Impact ourselves.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-22 in a headless browser on co2impact.co.uk's homepage pricing section, and in the vendor's llms.txt the same day; excluding VAT) The table has changed again. It now has three plans: Essentials for 2 users and 2 sites, Professional for 10 users and 5 sites, and Enterprise for unlimited users and sites. Loaded from outside the UK, the homepage showed euro prices: Essentials €47.00 a month or €564 a year, Professional €95.00 a month or €1,140 a year, and Enterprise €239.00 a month or €2,868 a year. The vendor's llms.txt lists the same three plans in sterling: Essentials £468 per year (£39 a month equivalent), Professional £948 per year (£79 a month equivalent) and Enterprise £2388 per year (£199 a month equivalent). We could not load the sterling table on the homepage itself, so the pound amounts come from llms.txt. Every plan is a 12-month licence: the page says annual payment is charged upfront and monthly payment is over a 12-month licence. Every plan lists the web platform (manual or Excel upload), the mobile app, bill and receipt forwarding by email, a ChatGPT plugin, full Scope 1, 2 and 3 reporting, a carbon reduction plan and multiple emission reports by activity; Professional adds SECR reporting and Metrics, and Enterprise adds manufactured products. The llms.txt also describes a 7-day free trial of the Basic plan with no card, up to 10 entries per activity category and no reports, and still names a plan that the table no longer shows. Earlier reads: on 19 November 2026 the homepage showed Basic £348 a year for 1 user and 1 site, Professional £549 and Premium £948, and on 9 and 22 October 2026 four plans starting with Basic at £468 a year. The licence terms (last updated 21 September 2026) add a Usage Token allowance per plan and paid top-ups whose prices are shown only inside the platform.
